note: Single re-review verdict (latest-word-wins overturn of the 2026-07-17 drop). The 07-17 DROP judged an internal contradiction in the DATA - 'TruMoo Whole Chocolate Milk Half Gallon' with size recorded as 'gallon', halving the per-floz price - not a wrong product class. Measured across the live 14-day Walmart union (CORRECTED by the post-batch review 2026-07-30: the original note undercounted the exposure): every capture since 07-23 derives the size from Walmart's own arithmetic (64.364 fl oz / 63.922 fl oz for the half gallon, the separate Gallon item at 126.744 fl oz); the bad size='gallon' row lives in TWO files, walmart-regular-2026-07-15.json AND walmart-regular-2026-07-18.json - the 07-15 file was still inside the union of the board anchored at ads-today 2026-07-29 (|07-15 to 07-29| = 14.0, inclusive) and ages out at the 07-30 anchor, while the 07-18 file stays in-window through the 2026-08-01 board and first leaves on 2026-08-02 (the window test is inclusive -le 14). The per-commodity freshness ranker prices the cell from the corrected newest rows throughout, which is why no wrong price shipped. TruMoo chocolate milk IS chocolate milk; keeping the drop would suppress a now-correct cell.
